# Public Social Account Analyzer Full Documentation

> Agent Skill & CLI toolkit for auditing public creator accounts across Bilibili, Douyin, Weibo & Xiaohongshu with immutable audit artifacts.

- **Repository**: https://github.com/Luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer
- **Author**: Luckycat133
- **License**: MIT
- **Runtime**: Python >= 3.9

---

## 1. Supported Platform Matrix

| Platform | Capability | Support Tier | Primary Extraction Pipeline |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bilibili (B站)** | Full public profile, video history, tags, engagement | P0 (Production) | Bounded retry, public API + optional session |
| **Douyin (抖音)** | Video statistics, captions, play counts | P0 (Experimental) | SSR / ephemeral browser, creator OpenAPI |
| **Weibo (微博)** | Post timeline, reposts, comments count | P1 (Experimental) | Public AJAX pipelines |
| **Xiaohongshu (小红书)** | Note cards, interaction stats, keywords | P1 (Experimental) | Modern/legacy state parsing, partial sample safeguards |

---

## 2. Core Architectural Guarantees

1. **Immutable Audit Artifacts**: Each collection attempt writes to a segregated, timestamped directory. Historical evidence is never mutated.
2. **Defensive Rate-Limit & Login-Wall Handling**: The collector immediately halts on captchas, login walls, or throttling. It never fabricates empty records as "success".
3. **Agent-Native Discovery**: Agents take raw creator names, discover canonical profile URLs via search, and drive collection without manual link provision.

---

## 3. Quickstart

```bash
# As OpenClaw Agent Skill
openclaw skills install @luckycat133/public-social-account-analyzer

# Local setup
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"

# Collect Bilibili creator profile
python3 skill/scripts/collect_bilibili_complete.py \
  "https://space.bilibili.com/<uid>" \
  --out-prefix workspace/bilibili-collection

# Generate analytics report
python3 skill/scripts/run_pipeline.py \
  --input workspace/bilibili-collection-attempt-1 \
  --output workspace/bilibili-analysis
```
